description: Rank ready-made scrapers by saved 30-day aggregate usage, success rate and recorded price. Evidence includes the snapshot date and age, not a live execution test. min_success_rate must be a finite number from 0 to 1 inclusive; zero includes unknown rates, while a positive minimum requires a known rate at or above the threshold. site: website name or domain, e.g. 'zillow', 'amazon.com', 'google maps', 'linkedin jobs'.
name: find_scrapers
